messages:
Eli (design): Quick spot-check from the morning sync pushed to staging: tightened dark palette, dialed down code-block bloom, and a new compact chart palette for small multiples. Posting screenshots + a short CSS diff. Please quick-look on different OS/scales.

Priya: On first glance the inline token hl is better but still reads thin on scaled Windows displays. Axe reports 3.0:1 on 12px snippets (below our preferred 4.5).

Samir: Area chart stacking still mashes colors at low opacity. For small multiples I recommend flat fills + distinct shaped markers (diamond/circle/square) for the first three series.

Jo: Copy nit: "reserve dedicated GPU capacity" reads fine. Also the toggle focus is still subtle when the side panel blur is applied. Could we increase ring weight and use an opaque color?

Luca: Palette pitch: move token highlight to #C48F00 and try #D2A800 for hover. theme-bot contrast pls.

theme-bot: contrast-check: #C48F00 on #0C0F12 => 4.4:1; #D2A800 => 4.9:1. simulated-cvd: both hold up for deutan/protan, but #D2A800 slightly higher vibrancy.

Priya: Prefer #C48F00 for less glare. Also suggest reducing the code-block shadow from 8px -> 4px and lowering opacity to 0.3.

Eli (design): OK locking token -> #C48F00. Chart palette I'm proposing (teal, steel, orchid, amber, coral) with shape markers and 2px strokes on mobile. CSS snippet in PR: ```
:root{--bg:#0C0F12;--panel:rgba(12,15,18,0.76);--code-bg:#0b0e11;--code-shadow:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);--token:#C48F00;--chart-1:#34D1CC;--chart-2:#4A7AE8;--chart-3:#B68AFB;--chart-4:#E6B64A;--chart-5:#FB7E92;--focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(38,99,255,0.18);}
```

theme-bot: cvd-sim: primary palette passes automated tests; chart-4 vs chart-5 reduced separation at low saturation but shapes compensate.

Samir: For line rendering, set stroke-alignment to outside and use 2px on <48px high charts. Toggle AA off for crispness.

Jo: I'll update tooltip copy and add alt text for thumbnails. Also adding a "High contrast" toggle that switches to a 7:1 palette for users who need it.

Luca: Please verify on macOS retina and Ubuntu fractional scaling. Gamma differences can nudge amber into a brighter band on OLED.

Eli (design): Great notes. I'll open the PR with screenshots: mac retina, win125%, ubuntu fractional. Tagging QE and @Priya for copy pass. If anyone sees color flicker or buzz, paste screenshots here and I'll iterate.
